microaneurysm.comment: Small dark blobs: top-hat on inverted green at small scales; tight size + circularity; vessel-overlap veto.

hemorrhage.comment: Larger dark/red regions: regional darkness vs median-blurred background + red darkness (top-hat misses soft-edged blotches). Areas set from IDRiD GT sizes (median HE ~34 working-px at 1072).

hard_exudate.comment: Bright yellow compact lesions: luminance gate + yellowness min(R,G)-B gate (saturation does NOT separate yellow exudates from reddish background — measured). Optic-disc exclusion mandatory.

soft_exudate.comment: Pale, fluffy, low-saturation bright regions, larger and irregular: modest luminance gate + LOW saturation gate (cotton-wool is paler than reddish background). Weakly tuned (only 2 SE-positive tuning images).

optic_disc_exclusion.comment: Dilated 4B disc circle zeroed for bright-lesion detectors. LOW_CONFIDENCE -> smaller dilation + warning; NOT_DETECTED -> no exclusion + warning.

candidate_scoring.comment: Status cutoffs shared by all four detectors (heuristic evidence confidence, NOT probability).

postprocessing.comment: Conservative: hole filling + FOV clipping only. No aggressive smoothing (MA safety).

_comment: SIH26038 Phase 4D — lesion evidence baseline. ENGINEERING HEURISTICS tuned on 8 IDRiD training images (IDRiD_01..08) only, frozen thereafter. Areas are given at reference_width and scaled by (working_width/reference_width)^2. Weights sum to 1.0 per detector.
